title: 03704 - B10B3/037043
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Function Restriction due to Implausible Message(s) from other Control Module(s)
Fault Code stored in other Control Module(s)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Resolve Fault Codes in other Control Module(s) first
technicalNotes: When found in Vehicles with VW Airbag Generation VW8R or VW10G, check Brake Electronics Control Module (J104/#03) for Fault Code 01486. If this Fault Code 01486 is stored, make sure to perform the System Function Test for the Brake Electronics first. Once the System Function Test is successful the Fault Code in the Airbag Control Module can be cleared.
